description: This is a Java source file implementing the ProductRelationshipService interface, providing business logic for managing product relationships within an e-commerce system including group management, CRUD operations, and queries based on product, group, and relationship type.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements the business logic for handling product relationships, including group management and retrieval based on product, group, type, and store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new product relationship or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group of product relationships associated with a store.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all groups of product relationships for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes all product relationships associated with a specified group.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Marks all relationships in a group as inactive.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Marks all relationships in a group as active.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific product relationship after retrieving it by ID.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Lists all relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships by type, product, store, and language as applicable.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships associated with a specific group within a store.
